title: test(types): give the inert comment projection a subject that reddens (objectui#9768)
body:
Fixes #9768

The comment projection at the three `packages/types` readers was correct and **inert**. This gives it a subject it actually defends.

## Population first — the card's number was not re-derived, it was re-measured

⛔ The card asserted inertness over "16 interface bodies" and I could not reproduce that figure, so I established the population mechanically rather than inheriting it. Method: instrument `stripComments` in `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` to record every input plus its calling test file, run the three readers, restore the module from `HEAD` and verify the restore by blob hash, then replay each captured body through the readers' own member regex twice — once through the projection, once with no projection at all.

Reading (this run, on `6a0d1a435`):

| | |
|---|---|
| `stripComments` calls across the three readers | 67 |
| of those, bodies located in a tracked non-test file | 63 |
| synthetic string literals handed to `members()` | 4 |
| DISTINCT (file, interface) bodies | **20** — 10 declarations, 10 docs fences |
| bodies where the projection deletes at least one byte of prose | 17 / 20 |
| bodies where projection and NO projection give a different member map | **0 / 20** |

The 10 declarations are the nine overlay interfaces the `7081` reader enumerates plus `EmptySchema` in `feedback.ts`; the 10 fences are their docs pages plus `feedback/empty.mdx`. The projection is doing real work — it removes 11,754 bytes of prose from the `AlertDialogSchema` body alone — it simply never changes the answer.

## Triage's escalation condition: NOT met

⭐ No real subject reads differently with and without the projection (0 of 20), so there is no live defect, the three readers get nothing wrong today, and the grade does not move to p2. The fixture stays the right deliverable.

⚠️ One finding from the same run, which strengthens the card rather than weakening it: **all 4 synthetic literals are inert too**, including the one counter-probe that reads as though it exercised the projection — the `JSDoc stripping does not eat real rows` probe in `overlay-node-slot-doc-types-7082.test.ts`. Its member-shaped line sits behind a docblock gutter (three spaces and a star) while `members()` anchors on exactly two spaces followed by an identifier, so it passes identically with the projection removed. Before this change nothing in the tree, subject or literal, could force the guard.

## What this lands

Each of the three readers declares `CommentProjectionForcingSubject` and pins the member list it reads off it. The body carries a member-shaped row inside an **ordinary block comment** — no `*` gutter, so the row sits on the two-space anchor — and the pin reads the file off disk and extracts that body exactly as it extracts a declaration.

- ⛔ It is a SUBJECT, not a synthetic string handed to the reader: the shape is on disk, in a file the compiler reads (`tsconfig.test.json` covers these files, and two type-level legs per reader assert the declared rows), and the extraction path is the readers' own `interfaceBody` + `members`.
- It is declared per file, deliberately: each reader carries its OWN copy of `members()`, so a pin living in one file cannot red for a projection dropped in another.
- ⛔ Behaviour unchanged: no reader's projection, regex or subject list moved. `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` is untouched.

## Red before green — the ablation, both legs

The mutation is the same in both legs: `const bare = stripComments(body);` becomes `const bare = body;` in all three readers, proven on disk (3 markers injected, 0 surviving calls) before anything is read. Restoration is `git checkout HEAD -- ...` under a `trap`, verified by comparing each file's blob hash with its `HEAD` blob and by `git diff HEAD` coming back empty.

- **Leg A — the PRE-FIX state** (`6a0d1a435`, the three readers as they were), projection removed: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 155 passed (155)`, exit 0. ⇒ the guard was inert.
- **Leg B — with the forcing subject**, projection removed: `Test Files 3 failed (3)`, `Tests 3 failed | 158 passed (161)`, exit 1. One failure per reader, all on the same assertion:

```
× `members()` reads the two DECLARED rows and not the row in the comment
AssertionError: expected [ 'phantom', 'real', 'label' ] to deeply equal [ 'real', 'label' ]
```

⛔ Not a count that happened to move: the assertion that moved names the member LIST, and the subject is added rather than an existing one altered, so a grep count over the tree would read the same in both legs.

## Verification

Heavy legs through the shared lock at `../objectstack/scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, verdict lines quoted:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` — `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 33s · waited 0s` (three programs: `tsc --noEmit`, `tsconfig.examples.json`, `tsconfig.test.json`)
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types test` — `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 26s · waited 0s`; `Test Files 204 passed (204)`, `Tests 4777 passed (4777)`
- The three readers alone: `Tests 161 passed (161)` (155 before this change)

Gates, run by POPULATION rather than by name — each of these reads this diff while naming none of its paths:

- `check:comment-mask-corpus` exit 0 — `5078 files, 1 disagree (0 comment bytes read as code, 1517 code bytes read as comment)`, i.e. the objectui#7882 residue unchanged and inside its declared ceiling
- `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs` exit 0 — `6 private comment projection(s) in 5 file(s); DEBT names 5`; this diff adds no carrier and the DEBT ratchet does not move (the one regex added is a LOOKUP for the row, not a removal position)
- `check:pending-changeset-literals` exit 0, `markdown-test-inputs --audit` exit 0 (`102 candidate test files, all adjudicated`)
- `check:control-bytes` exit 0 (7890 tracked text files), `check:test-path-roots` exit 0 — the new read is rooted at the test file itself, never at the cwd
- `check:new-line-citations` exit 0 (`0 new citation(s)`), `check:changeset-claims` exit 0, `check-changeset-presence` exit 0 — the empty-frontmatter changeset is the declared exemption
- `node scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs` exit 0 (`46/46 packages linted, 0 with outstanding errors`); `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types lint` 0 errors (the two warnings printed against `overlay-trigger-union-7081.test.ts` are pre-existing `data?: any` rows, untouched by this diff)

⛔ `check:node-esm-load` is not coupled to this diff: nothing under any package's published `files[]` moves — `tsconfig.json` excludes `**/__tests__/**` from the build — so no dist artefact changes. It is named here as a deliberate omission rather than left unsaid.

## Acceptance notes

- noted, not filed: the four synthetic literals in these readers' counter-probes all pass with the projection removed, so the probes named for JSDoc stripping measure the member regex rather than the projection. Carrier for a later repair: whoever next edits those probes; ⛔ not filed, because they are honest as tests of the regex and this pull request now supplies what they were mistaken for.
- The `16 interface bodies` figure on the card is not reproducible against the readers' actual subject lists. It is consistent with a count over one reader's docs pages plus the declarations (`10 + 6`), but that is a reconstruction, not a reading — I am reporting 20, measured, with the method above.
